title: How Well Do You REALLY Know Movies? 🎬 50 Movie Trivia Questions | Movies Quiz #12
description_hook: 🎬 From Pixar to blockbusters: 50 movie questions that'll sort the film buffs from the popcorn munchers.

questions.note: Giulia, 6 Nov 2026: no approval stops; fully automated. Written and fact-checked by Claude 10 Nov 2026. Family-friendly (Giulia 10 Nov); GIF picks avoid real actors where possible.

questions.question: In Finding Nemo, what kind of fish is Nemo?
questions.reveal: His dad Marlin crosses the whole ocean to find him.

questions.question: Which 1997 film about a doomed ocean liner won 11 Oscars?
questions.reveal: It tied the record set by Ben-Hur, later matched by The Return of the King.

questions.question: What is the name of the snowman in Frozen?
questions.reveal: He likes warm hugs.

questions.question: In the 1939 film The Wizard of Oz, what colour are Dorothy's slippers?
questions.reveal: In L. Frank Baum's original book, they were silver.

questions.question: In Jaws, what kind of animal terrorises the beaches of Amity Island?
questions.reveal: The mechanical shark kept breaking down, so the director showed it as little as possible.

questions.question: In The Lion King, what does 'Hakuna Matata' mean?
questions.reveal: It's a Swahili phrase, made famous by Timon and Pumbaa.

questions.question: Which film's famous line is 'To infinity and beyond!'?
questions.reveal: Buzz Lightyear says it, and it became one of Pixar's most quoted lines.

questions.question: What is the name of the green ogre who lives in a swamp?
questions.reveal: Shrek won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature.

questions.question: In Despicable Me, what are Gru's small yellow helpers called?
questions.reveal: They speak their own language, a mix of words from lots of real languages.

questions.question: Which film series follows hobbits on a quest to destroy a powerful ring?
questions.reveal: The books were written by J.R.R. Tolkien.

questions.question: In Up, what lifts Carl's house into the sky?
questions.reveal: Thousands of helium balloons, tied to the chimney.

questions.question: In which film does an alien who wants to 'phone home' befriend a boy called Elliott?
questions.reveal: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial was released in 1982.

questions.question: Which director made Jaws, E.T. and Jurassic Park?
questions.reveal: He's one of the most successful film directors of all time.

questions.question: In Toy Story, what's the name of the cowboy doll?
questions.reveal: He's Andy's favourite toy, until Buzz Lightyear arrives.

questions.question: Which 2016 Disney film features the song 'How Far I'll Go'?
questions.reveal: Moana sails across the ocean with the demigod Maui.

questions.question: In Finding Nemo, what's the name of the blue tang fish with short-term memory loss?
questions.reveal: Just keep swimming!

questions.question: Which country was The Lord of the Rings trilogy mainly filmed in?
questions.reveal: Hobbiton, the village set, is still open to visitors.

questions.question: In Jurassic Park, scientists got dinosaur DNA from mosquitoes trapped in what?
questions.reveal: Amber is fossilised tree resin.

questions.question: Which animated film features a rat who dreams of being a chef in Paris?
questions.reveal: The rat's name is Remy.

questions.question: In The Incredibles, what is the superhero family's surname?
questions.reveal: Mr Incredible's real name is Bob Parr.

questions.question: Which Pixar film takes place inside the mind of a girl called Riley?
questions.reveal: Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust run her headquarters.

questions.question: In Monsters, Inc., what powers the city of Monstropolis?
questions.reveal: By the end, they find out that laughter is even more powerful.

questions.question: In One Hundred and One Dalmatians, what's the name of the villain who wants a spotty coat?
questions.reveal: She's one of Disney's most famous villains.

questions.question: Which Pixar film has a little robot cleaning up an abandoned Earth?
questions.reveal: He falls for a sleek robot called EVE.

questions.question: What kind of animal is Baloo in The Jungle Book?
questions.reveal: He sings 'The Bare Necessities'.

questions.question: In Mary Poppins, a spoonful of sugar helps what go down?
questions.reveal: In the most delightful way!

questions.question: In The Chronicles of Narnia, what is the name of the great lion?
questions.reveal: The children reach Narnia through a wardrobe.

questions.question: Which country does Paddington Bear come from?
questions.reveal: Darkest Peru, to be exact. He loves marmalade sandwiches.

questions.question: In Kung Fu Panda, what's the name of the panda who becomes the Dragon Warrior?
questions.reveal: He's a noodle-loving panda who's mad about kung fu.

questions.question: In Cars, what's the name of the red race car?
questions.reveal: Ka-chow!

questions.question: Which 2008 film kicked off the Marvel Cinematic Universe?
questions.reveal: Tony Stark ends the film by telling the world: 'I am Iron Man.'

questions.question: Which 2009 film is set on the moon Pandora, home of the blue Na'vi?
questions.reveal: It's still one of the highest-grossing films ever made.

questions.question: In Ice Age, what's the name of the sabre-toothed squirrel who's obsessed with an acorn?
questions.reveal: He barely speaks, but he steals every scene.

questions.question: What is the name of Thor's magical hammer?
questions.reveal: Only someone who is worthy can lift it.

questions.question: In Back to the Future, how fast must the DeLorean go to travel through time?
questions.reveal: It also needs 1.21 gigawatts of power.

questions.question: In Black Panther, what is the name of T'Challa's hidden African nation?
questions.reveal: Wakanda forever!

questions.question: How many Infinity Stones are there in the Marvel films?
questions.reveal: Space, Mind, Reality, Power, Time and Soul.

questions.question: In Guardians of the Galaxy, what are the only three words Groot says?
questions.reveal: He says them in different ways to mean different things.

questions.question: Which secret agent has the code number 007?
questions.reveal: He was created by the author Ian Fleming.

questions.question: In Charlie and the Chocolate Factory, what are Willy Wonka's small workers called?
questions.reveal: They come from a place called Loompaland.

questions.question: In Home Alone, where is Kevin's family flying to when they leave him behind?
questions.reveal: Kevin defends the house from two burglars with homemade traps.

questions.question: In The Sound of Music, how many von Trapp children are there?
questions.reveal: The film is set in Salzburg, Austria.

questions.question: Which Pixar film is centred on Mexico's Day of the Dead?
questions.reveal: Miguel journeys to the Land of the Dead to find his family's story.

questions.question: Which comic-book company's heroes include Iron Man, Thor and Captain America?
questions.reveal: Its films are known as the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

questions.question: In Pinocchio, what happens when Pinocchio tells a lie?
questions.reveal: His conscience is a cricket called Jiminy.

questions.question: In the 1933 film, which New York building does King Kong climb?
questions.reveal: It was the world's tallest building at the time.

questions.question: In The Wizard of Oz, what does the Tin Man want from the Wizard?
questions.reveal: The Scarecrow wants a brain and the Lion wants courage.

questions.question: What's the name of Kristoff's reindeer in Frozen?
questions.reveal: Kristoff often 'speaks' for him in a silly voice.

questions.question: Which 2023 film about a famous doll was the highest-grossing film of that year worldwide?
questions.reveal: It took more than 1.4 billion US dollars at the box office.

questions.question: In Star Wars, what is the name of Han Solo's spaceship?
questions.reveal: Han says it made the Kessel Run in less than twelve parsecs.

tags_research: vidIQ keyword research 10 Nov 2026 ('movie quiz' ~45k searches/month; 'movie trivia quiz' ~4.6k; 'movies quiz' ~4k). 'guess the movie' left out: this isn't a guess-the-movie format.
